history.note: The weights GridIron launched with: ratings tuned on 2019-22 (hp2.json), backup-QB value and win-probability calibration fitted on 2019-22, blend chosen in backtesting. Factors that failed their held-out tests start at zero weight.

live_history.note: The live model GridIron launched with: fitted on 2019-22 play-by-play (livewp.py), tail calibration kept after a 2022 validation check.

players_history.note: Launch weights for multi-season player projections: this season's games before the week at full weight plus last season's at x0.1 (the best of 0 to 1 on 2021-22, before the evaluation seasons were looked at). Sample-trust constants, simulator spread and injury absorption are the values the 2025-only model used (fit_k.json, fit_cal.json, absorb.json); those were tuned on 2025 weeks, so the review's comparisons on 2025 favour keeping them.
